title: Personality and temperament
learning_outcomes: Explain trait models in the context of personality and temperament.
Compare and distinguish situational variation in the context of personality and temperament.
Apply measurement in the context of personality and temperament.
Evaluate and justify decisions about cultural context in the context of personality and temperament.

lessons.title: Trait models
lessons.outcome: Explain trait models in the context of personality and temperament.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving trait models; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to personality-test critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain trait models from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of trait models; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Situational variation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish situational variation in the context of personality and temperament.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving situational variation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to personality-test critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain situational variation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of situational variation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Measurement
lessons.outcome: Apply measurement in the context of personality and temperament.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving measurement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to personality-test critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain measurement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of measurement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cultural context
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about cultural context in the context of personality and temperament.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cultural context; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to personality-test critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cultural context from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cultural context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of trait models; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of situational variation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of measurement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cultural context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
